messages.author: 5ac577eb31f036be
messages.subject: Zero-inflated Poisson Distance Sampling Models
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I'm working with a large data set that has quite a few sites with no detections. I'm currently running hierarchical distance sampling models with the functions distsamp() and gdistsamp() in unmarked, but with so many sites with no detections, I was worried a bit about model fit. I know that gdistsamp allows for the negative binomial distribution in your response variable and I was wondering if there is any way to incorporate a zero-inflated poisson distribution into a distance sampling model in unmarked. 

Any guidance would be very welcome. 

Cheers,

-Tyler Hallman

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Zero-inflated Poisson Distance Sampling Models
parts:
hi Tyler,
 
 At this time there is not a ZIP option available for the distsamp functions, although this would be very easy to add.  As with everything else, until we find more time (or interested people) new features (or extensions) won't be added.

regards,
andy
